# FarmLink
FarmLink is a farm-to-market platform in Harare, Zimbabwe connecting smallholder farmers directly with buyers.
Farmers open free online stores and list produce; FarmLink verifies farms, collects produce, handles transport
and processes payments (EcoCash, OneMoney, bank transfer). Buyers choose checkpoint pickup ($3) or home delivery ($5).
FarmLink deducts a 10% service fee on produce; farmers receive 90% after delivery is confirmed.
Key pages: / (home), /market.html (produce), /stores.html (farmer stores), /farmer-signup.html (farmers apply),
/pricing.html (fees for buyers and farmers), /farm-logistics.html (collection routes and checkpoints),
/wholesale.html (standing weekly orders for retailers and kitchens), /case-studies.html (pilot results),
/about.html (story, team and guarantee), /blog.html (5 produce guides), /contact.html (inquiry form, replies within 1 business day),
/privacy.html, /terms.html. Opening hours: Mon–Sat 8am–5pm.
Technical: static site, no tracking cookies, no third-party scripts, HTTPS with strict security headers.
